source.note: Wave-1 row 18 named the Ultimate Animated Animals bat (poly.pizza, behind a Cloudflare challenge; its Google Drive is quota-blocked). This is the bat from Quaternius’s 2018 Animated Monster Pack (OpenGameArt, CC0), the reachable Quaternius bat with the clearest bat silhouette. Its eyes are skinned to a second armature that follows the Face bone through a Child Of constraint; the pipeline now folds that follower rig into the main one, so all five clips export with the eyes on the face. Until then the PR carried the chibi bat from the 2020 Textured Cute Monster Pack as a stand-in. The pack has no idle: a bat hovers, so idle and fly both play Bat_Flying; Bat_Attack2 (a second bite) keeps its source name. Height 0.3 m (ear tips to feet) gives a flight wingspan of about 0.36 m, a noctule-size bat; the head and ears are stylized large. Ground: in Bat_Flying, Bat_Attack, Bat_Attack2 and Bat_Hit the bat flaps in place and the downstroke sweeps its wingtips up to 49 mm below the feet, so these airborne clips carry a constant lift of 0.05 m (a hover that never sinks; clamping would jolt the body with every wingbeat). Bat_Death drops it onto its side on the ground and is clamped.
